assessments.reasoning: The exact handle redirected to the MIT Libraries DSpace publication record. Its title, issue date and series identify the Argus Reference Manual, November 1987, MIT-LCS-TR-400. The abstract identifies Argus as an experimental language and system for construction and execution of distributed programs.

challenge.method: Compared the handle and identity metadata with the MIT-hosted scan of the report. Tested whether the language name, integrated system, and publication denote one registry object.
challenge.results: The metadata identifies one report and its abstract describes an integrated language and system. The frozen condition limits the registry entity to the language named there.

limitations: The web extractor could not open the bare Handle URL. The first fresh HTTPS download followed it to MIT DSpace and matched the frozen catalog digest. A repeat request received HTTP 429. Registry active status is locally assigned.
